Big question: how does a dimmer switch change a lamp's brightness?
questions.a: It changes the resistance: more resistance means less current and a dimmer lamp.

questions.q: A lamp has 2 A through it and resistance 6 Ω. Voltage?
questions.model: Formula: V = I × R. Substitute: 2 × 6. Calculate: 12. Unit: V.

questions.a: Answers in the key, e.g. 250 mA through 40 Ω: 10 V.
questions.model: Teacher does question 1: 0.5 A through 20 Ω: V = 0.5 × 20 = 10 V.

questions.q: Explain how turning a dimmer up makes a lamp brighter.
questions.a: Resistance of the variable resistor decreases (1); total resistance falls so current increases (1); more energy transferred to the lamp per second (1).
